verdict.rationale: Supabase's own docs state that Pro, Team, and Enterprise projects get automatic daily backups, kept 7/14/up to 30 days by plan and visible in the dashboard. They also document Point-in-Time Recovery that restores to any chosen point with up to seconds of granularity, built on physical backups plus WAL archiving, so both parts of the story are covered first-party. Backups are limited to paid plans and PITR is a paid add-on; one community comment hedged with 'reportedly' and 'if true' questions the design of an older nightly backup but does not show backups failing. missing for 10: documented restore workflow and recovery-time details, independent hands-on corroboration of a PITR restore, backups/PITR on the free tier.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can rely on automated backups and point-in-time recovery for my data

citations.quote: We automatically back up all Pro, Team, and Enterprise Plan projects on a daily basis. You can find backups in the Database > Backups section of the Dashboard.
Point-in-Time Recovery (PITR) allows you to back up a project at shorter intervals, giving you the option to restore to any chosen point with up to seconds of granularity
